text.tspan: You click the mouse, but nothing. You find the power button and press it.
The computer starts and asks for a password, however there is no keyboard
and you don’t know the password. You also see a button that
says “Bored? Play Solitaire” however you ignore it. You bang the desk
out of frustration, and a sticky note falls on the floor reading “Password: 1232”.
You pocket the sticky note. What do you do after?
